reviewRules.intro: A review helps other drivers choose a garage. To stay published, it follows the rules below.

moderation.again: A removed review cannot be written again for the same job.
moderation.appeal: A removed review can be appealed once, within 14 days of its removal, and a different admin decides.
moderation.hidden: A reported review or reply is hidden until an admin decides, within 48 hours. Meanwhile the review does not count in the rating.
moderation.report: A garage can report a review, and the review’s author can report the garage’s reply.
moderation.title: How moderation works
moderation.told: Once decided, the author and the garage are told.

reviewRules.replies: The same rules apply to garages’ replies.

1.name: No insults.
1.why: Say what went wrong without insulting anyone.

2.name: No personal data.
2.why: No full names, phone numbers, addresses, e‑mails or number plates.

3.name: No ads.
3.why: No links, discount codes or announcements.

4.name: No promotion of other services.
4.why: Do not recommend another garage, mechanic or business.

5.name: Only about this repair and this garage.
5.why: Write about the work done, the price, the time and how you were treated.

6.name: No hate or discrimination.
6.why: Nothing about anyone’s origin, religion, gender or other traits.

7.name: No fake or conflicted reviews.
7.why: No paid reviews, none by staff or competitors, and none about a job that did not happen.

8.name: No threats or legal accusations stated as fact.
8.why: For a dispute, write to support.

reviewRules.title: Review rules
